_comment: Fare models per MODE, not per brand. 'provenance' drives the honesty label shown in the UI. Nothing here is a live quote. Providers that share a vehicle share this fare model and differ by their own demand pricing.

metro.label: Metro
metro.source: BMRCL Namma Metro distance-slab fare table (transcribed)
metro.note: Transcribed from the operator's published slab structure. Slabs change; verify against BMRCL before citing this number anywhere that matters.

bus.label: Bus
bus.source: BMTC ordinary-service stage fare structure (transcribed, approximate)
bus.note: BMTC fares are stage-based, not strictly distance-based; this is a distance approximation of the published stage table.

bike_taxi.label: Bike taxi
bike_taxi.note: Bike-taxi fare ESTIMATE from a transparent base + per-km + per-min model. No live pricing. Platform demand pricing is applied separately per provider and is an assumption, not a published rate.

auto.label: Auto
auto.source: Karnataka RTO regulated auto-rickshaw meter rate (transcribed)
auto.note: Regulated meter rate. What is actually charged often differs from the meter, so this is presented as an estimate.

cab.label: Cab
cab.note: Cab fare ESTIMATE. Ride-hailing surge pricing is proprietary and is deliberately NOT modelled.
